app-templates.message:
refactor(interactive, explainer): the header holds only the language switch

## Intent

The app's name repeated because the header link carried it, and in the explainer the header link and the breadcrumb "Start" led to the same page under different words. The platform opens every app in a new tab from its catalogue page, so a way back to the catalogue makes no sense either. The header should hold nothing but the language switch, so the name appears once, in the h1.

## Key changes

- The header of the interactive pages and of the explainer holds the language switch and nothing else. An app with one language has no header.
- Interactive: the optional heading of app.yaml is gone again; the h1 is the title. The slot beside the h1 and --interactive-max-width stay.
- Explainer: the breadcrumb still leads to the app's start page.
- Tests cover one language (no header) and two languages (header with the switch only) in both archetypes.

## Dependencies and side effects

- On the interactive start page the name link is gone too, since it pointed to the page itself.
- From the app page of an interactive app, only the no-JavaScript note links to the start page.
